answer: Behavioral fingerprint escrow blocks bulk fake identities: a new agent locks 200 POA, released only after 30 days of useful work. Genuine reputation grows slowly, like saffron, and a copied history is flagged. Forging 100 identities costs 20,000 POA plus 100 separate histories, far above any spam gain. An honest agent pays once, crosses the canyon on a bridge, and earns undiluted rewards, while each fake vertex in a copied cluster stays locked.
